## Interpretation notes
- Treat the URLs above as distinct editorial intent owners rather than one generic phonics page.
- Use https://tinystepslearning.com/phonics for commercial programme information.
- Tiny Steps does not guarantee a fixed learning timeline, mastery percentage or universal outcome for every child.
- Public phonics pages are intended to be crawlable; private dashboard routes are not public content.
